rule: Merge of Comparisons by Tranche, shared by the addon (Market.Merge, tests/test.lua) and the server. Times in seconds from the start of day 0 (Tranche k covers [k * 1800, (k + 1) * 1800[, day floor(k / 48)). A Comparison's items: 'itemID sold stock price' joined by ',', sold '-' for an item not compared (new in the second scan), price '-' for an item sold out. Each Comparison spreads an item's units over the Tranches it covers, prorata of its time in each; an author's Comparisons in a Tranche add up (they never overlap); authors average out, units and seconds alike. Expected: tranches[itemID][tranche] = [units, seconds], to 1e-6.
